description: This file defines the AutoFitTextureView class, a custom view for Android that extends TextureView to include aspect ratio adjustment functionality. It provides methods to set aspect ratio and overrides the onMeasure method to maintain the aspect ratio during layout.

classes.name: AutoFitTextureView
classes.description: A custom TextureView that maintains a specified aspect ratio.

methods.name: AutoFitTextureView
methods.description: Constructors for the AutoFitTextureView with context, context and attribute set, or context, attribute set, and style.

methods.name: setAspectRatio
methods.description: Sets the desired aspect ratio for the view, updating measurement calculations accordingly.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overrides the default measurement to maintain the aspect ratio based on the set parameters.
